description: This file defines the LogFragment class, a fragment used in an Android application to display log data via a LogView component. It includes methods to create and initialize the view hierarchy, set up UI components, and handle text change events to auto-scroll the log display.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that hosts a LogView for displaying logs, with auto-scrolling functionality when new log data is appended.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Constructs a ScrollView containing a configured LogView, sets layout parameters, padding, typeface, and appearance.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the UI by setting up the view hierarchy and attaches a TextWatcher to auto-scroll the log view when text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
